Crucible: Evaluating LLM Agents in Executable Chemistry Research Environments
description: Large language models (LLMs) perform well on chemistry knowledge benchmarks, which mainly assess question answering and isolated tasks. Chemical research, however, requires using specialized tools and interpreting their outputs to obtain chemically valid results. To address this gap, we introduce Crucible Bench to evaluate this ability across all four stages of the design-make-test-analyze (DMTA)
authors: Yinjun Liu, Xinye Li, Ruisen Peng

title: Connecting AI Agents to Live Discrete Element Simulations via the Model Context Protocol
